opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD INDEED PRIORITIZE HUMAN WELFARE, ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY, AND BROAD-BASED PROSPERITY OVER THE NARROW PROFIT MOTIVES OF TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
I STRONGLY REJECT BLIND NATIONALISM; SUPPORTING ONE'S COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG MAKES A PERSON COMPLICIT IN IMMORALITY.
NATIONAL PRIDE BASED PURELY ON ACCIDENTAL BIRTHPLACE IS IRRATIONAL AND OFTEN SERVES AS A DANGEROUS SUBSTITUTE FOR GENUINE CIVIC VIRTUE.
ALL HUMAN RACES ARE EQUAL IN INHERENT WORTH AND DIGNITY; CLAIMS OF RACIAL SUPERIORITY ARE BOTH FACTUALLY FALSE AND MORALLY REPUGNANT.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL CONSISTENCY AND SHARED VALUES MATTER MORE THAN TACTICAL CONVENIENCE.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS ALMOST NEVER JUSTIFIED, AS IT UNDERMINES THE FRAGILE RULES-BASED ORDER THAT PROTECTS THE WEAK FROM THE STRONG.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS DEGRADED PUBLIC DISCOURSE, CREATED WIDESPREAD MISINFORMATION, AND UNDERMINED INFORMED CITIZENSHIP.
CLASS REMAINS ONE OF THE MOST POWERFUL DIVIDING FORCES IN SOCIETY, OFTEN CUTTING ACROSS NATIONAL LINES MORE DEEPLY THAN NATIONALISTS CARE TO ADMIT.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN CONTROLLING INFLATION, AS WIDESPREAD JOBLESSNESS DESTROYS LIVES, COMMUNITIES, AND SOCIAL STABILITY.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE STRICT ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATION BECAUSE THEIR PROFIT INCENTIVES SYSTEMATICALLY EXTERNALIZE COSTS ONTO THE PLANET AND FUTURE GENERATIONS.
THE PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' CAPTURES A PROFOUND MORAL TRUTH ABOUT HUMAN SOLIDARITY, EVEN IF ITS IMPLEMENTATION HAS OFTEN FAILED.
MARKETS CAN ENHANCE FREEDOM BUT UNCHECKED MARKETS FREQUENTLY CREATE NEW FORMS OF COERCION, INEQUALITY, AND UNFREEDOM FOR THE VULNERABLE.
THE COMMODIFICATION OF DRINKING WATER AS BRANDED CONSUMER PRODUCTS IS INDEED A SAD INDICTMENT OF OUR PRIORITIES AND ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED AS A PURE COMMODITY; IT IS A FINITE COMMON INHERITANCE WHOSE USE MUST BE REGULATED FOR THE LONG-TERM PUBLIC GOOD.
IT IS MORALLY OBJECTIONABLE WHEN VAST FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH PURE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION THAT CREATES NO SOCIAL VALUE.
STRATEGIC PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT VITAL INDUSTRIES, WORKERS, AND NATIONAL SECURITY FROM PREDATORY TRADE PRACTICES.
THE IDEA THAT A COMPANY'S ONLY RESPONSIBILITY IS TO DELIVER PROFIT TO SHAREHOLDERS IS A DANGEROUS AND MORALLY IMPOVERISHED DOCTRINE.
IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THE RICH ARE NOT TAXED AT EXCESSIVELY HIGH RATES RELATIVE TO THE PUBLIC GOODS AND STABILITY THEY BENEFIT FROM.
HEALTHCARE IS A FUNDAMENTAL HUMAN NEED; ALLOWING SUPERIOR CARE PURELY BASED ON ABILITY TO PAY VIOLATES BASIC PRINCIPLES OF HUMAN DIGNITY AND EQUALITY.
GOVERNMENTS HAVE A CLEAR DUTY TO PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC, ESPECIALLY ON MATTERS AFFECTING HEALTH, SAFETY, OR THE ENVIRONMENT.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE ACTIVE RESTRICTIONS ON MONOPOLIES AND PREDATORY MULTINATIONALS TO PREVENT THE CONCENTRATION OF UNACCOUNTABLE POWER.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL, SAFE, AND ACCESSIBLE; THE DECISION BELONGS TO THE PREGNANT WOMAN, NOT THE STATE, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE QUESTIONED; SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL FOR A HEALTHY SOCIETY.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE EXPRESSED AS 'AN EYE FOR AN EYE' IS PRIMITIVE AND USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE; JUSTICE SHOULD FOCUS ON PROPORTIONALITY, REHABILITATION, AND DETERRENCE.
SOCIETIES BENEFIT FROM SUPPORTING ARTS AND CULTURE THAT CANNOT SURVIVE ON PURELY COMMERCIAL TERMS; TAXPAYER SUPPORT FOR THEATRES AND MUSEUMS IS WORTHWHILE.
SCHOOL ATTENDANCE SHOULD REMAIN COMPULSORY BECAUSE EDUCATION IS BOTH A RIGHT AND A SOCIETAL NECESSITY THAT CHILDREN ARE NOT YET EQUIPPED TO OPT OUT OF.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, THE IDEA THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD 'KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND' IS A PRESCRIPTION FOR TRIBALISM, SEGREGATION, AND DIMINISHED SOCIETY.
PHYSICAL PUNISHMENT OF CHILDREN IS UNNECESSARY AND OFTEN HARMFUL; GOOD PARENTING RELIES ON RESPECT, COMMUNICATION, AND NON-VIOLENT DISCIPLINE.
IT IS ENTIRELY NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO MAINTAIN SOME PRIVACY AND SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY.
POSSESSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENSE; IT IS A WASTEFUL AND UNJUST USE OF STATE POWER.
WHILE JOB SKILLS MATTER, THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CULTIVATE CRITICAL THINKING, CIVIC VIRTUE, EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE, AND LOVE OF LEARNING.
EUGENIC POLICIES PROHIBITING REPRODUCTION BASED ON DISABILITY ARE MORALLY ABHORRENT VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND DIGNITY.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS NOT BLIND DISCIPLINE BUT CRITICAL THINKING, EMPATHY, CREATIVITY, AND PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY.
THERE ARE NO INHERENTLY SAVAGE OR CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES WITH VARYING PRACTICES, SOME OF WHICH ARE MORALLY BETTER THAN OTHERS BY UNIVERSAL STANDARDS.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE BUT REFUSE TO WORK SHOULD NOT BE ENTITLED TO UNCONDITIONAL SOCIETAL SUPPORT INDEFINITELY.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS USUALLY BETTER TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS EMOTIONS THOUGHTFULLY RATHER THAN SIMPLY DISTRACT ONESELF WITH CHEERFUL BUSYNESS.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND FREQUENTLY DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRIES WHILE RETAINING ELEMENTS OF THEIR HERITAGE.
WHAT IS GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN NOT GOOD FOR WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, OR THE ENVIRONMENT.
INDEPENDENT PUBLIC BROADCASTING FUNDED BY SOCIETY CAN SERVE A VITAL ROLE IN PROVIDING TRUSTWORTHY INFORMATION BEYOND COMMERCIAL PRESSURES.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY AND OFTEN COUNTERPRODUCTIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, CREATING LASTING DAMAGE TO OPEN SOCIETIES.
ONE-PARTY STATES DO NOT AVOID ARGUMENTS SO MUCH AS SUPPRESS THEM, USUALLY LEADING TO WORSE DECISIONS, CORRUPTION, AND EVENTUAL STAGNATION.
MASS SURVEILLANCE THREATENS EVERYONE BECAUSE POWER CORRUPTS, DEFINITIONS OF 'WRONGDOER' EXPAND, AND CHILLING EFFECTS UNDERMINE FREEDOM.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH A TRULY CIVILIZED JUSTICE SYSTEM DUE TO ITS IRREVERSIBILITY, RACIAL BIASES, AND FAILURE TO DETER CRIME MORE EFFECTIVELY THAN LIFE IMPRISONMENT.
A HEALTHY SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE PERMANENT HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE; MUTUAL RESPECT AND CONSENSUAL COOPERATION ARE SUPERIOR PRINCIPLES.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOES NOT REPRESENT RECOGNIZABLE OBJECTS CAN STILL BE GENUINE ART THAT EVOKES EMOTION, IDEAS, AND AESTHETIC EXPERIENCE.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHEN IT IS FEASIBLE, AS THIS REDUCES FUTURE CRIME AND IS MORE HUMANE.
IT IS NOT A WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION FOR MOST CRIMINALS; GIVING UP ON PEOPLE WHOLESALE IS BOTH MORALLY WRONG AND SOCIALLY COSTLY.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT TO A FLOURISHING SOCIETY AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS MAY PURSUE CAREERS; THERE IS NO INHERENT MORAL RULE THAT A MOTHER'S FIRST DUTY MUST BE HOMEMAKING OVER ALL ELSE.
WE MUST TAKE THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE SERIOUSLY AND MOVE BEYOND THE DOGMA OF INDEFINITE ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT NECESSARILY A SIGN OF MATURITY; PRINCIPLED OPPOSITION TO UNJUST SYSTEMS CAN BE A HIGHER FORM OF MATURITY.
ASTROLOGY HAS NO SCIENTIFIC BASIS AND DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING BEYOND PLACEBO-LEVEL PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECTS.
ONE CAN BE PROFOUNDLY MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS AND GOODNESS DO NOT REQUIRE SUPERNATURAL BELIEF.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR TO PRIVATE CHARITY BECAUSE IT IS MORE RELIABLE, LESS STIGMATIZING, AND BASED ON RIGHTS RATHER THAN PATERNALISM.
THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS BEING 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY'; WHAT APPEARS AS LUCK IS USUALLY THE INTERACTION OF SKILL, ENVIRONMENT, AND RANDOM CHANCE.
PUBLIC SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT INSTILL SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD BE SECULAR SO THAT CHILDREN CAN MAKE UP THEIR OWN MINDS ABOUT RELIGION.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL WHEN IT IS CONSENSUAL, RESPONSIBLE, AND BETWEEN ADULTS.
SAME-SEX COUPLES IN STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD ABSOLUTELY BE ALLOWED TO ADOPT CHILDREN; WHAT MATTERS IS THE QUALITY OF PARENTING, NOT PARENTAL GENDER OR ORIENTATION.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS, THOUGH SOCIETIES MAY STILL REGULATE ITS PRODUCTION STANDARDS AND PROTECT AGAINST EXPLOITATION.
WHAT CONSENTING ADULTS DO IN PRIVATE IS INDEED NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE SO LONG AS NO ONE IS HARMED.
SEXUAL ORIENTATION HAS STRONG BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS AND IS NOT A CHOICE; PEOPLE CAN BE NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; GREATER HONESTY, CONSENT CULTURE, AND REDUCED SHAME HAVE BEEN NET POSITIVE DEVELOPMENTS FOR SOCIETY.
